_comment: Extra read-only mirrors of the same tree. Everything here is added to art.json / mirrors.json and to the site's speed test automatically — so pointing a new CDN at the bucket is one entry, not a code change. These are origins we do NOT deploy to; the r2 origin and the Pages origin are handled by the sync itself.

_example.note: AWS CloudFront in front of the R2 bucket

extraOrigins.note: 同一个桶 stronghold-assets 的第二个自定义域名：零额外存储、不占额度，只多一个入口。它不跟随 speedcdn 改名 —— 第二个自定义域名要靠 DNS/CF 侧新建才有，仓里改字符串造不出一个主机，而 weishucdn2 实测仍在服务同一份 index.json（与 speedcdn 逐字节同长 1,786,476）。改名只对主入口做。行为与 speedcdn 逐头核对一致（200/206、ACAO *、expose Content-Length/Content-Range/ETag、immutable），因为 zone 那条 CORS 改写规则的表达式已同时覆盖两个 host。

_git_comment: Origins that mount files out of THIS git repository through a public mirror chain. The interface files live on `main`; the 618 MiB art tree lives on the orphan branch `assets-raw`, committed 2026-10-09 specifically so git-mount CDNs can serve it. Coverage is therefore FULL for every entry here: git-mount sources were only ever 'partial' because the asset tree had not been committed, not because the mirrors could not carry it. Each entry still carries its own probe path. Statically is not listed: it truncated a 262,144-byte probe to 16,384 / 32,768 / 0 bytes across three attempts and 403'd 5/5 on a real 854 KB asset.

gitOrigins.note: jsDelivr 挂载本仓 git 内容（接口文件在 main，素材树在 assets-raw）
ghfast 镜像链挂载 raw.githubusercontent（国内可用）
jsDelivr 挂载素材树（assets-raw 分支）：MIME/ACAO/Range 206 已实测
ghfast 挂载素材树（assets-raw 分支）：MIME/ACAO/Range 206 已实测
自有域中转（sp-git-mount-relay）：一个域名同时服务接口文件与素材树，按路径自动选分支；后端按 jsdelivr→ghfast 顺序回退

_disabled_comment: Parked origin ids. Unlike `retired`, these are NOT removed: the entry stays in the interface carrying `enabled:false`, so a selector will not choose it while its measured history and the operator's intent (it is meant to come back) both survive. Parked is for a degraded backend; retired is for one that is gone.
_preferred_order_comment: Presentation order for the origin list, by id. This is not a ranking -- clients choose from the measured speed table, which is built from real probes. Use it only when measurement is the wrong answer, e.g. a slower backend that does not consume request quota. Unlisted origins keep their built order and come after the listed ones.
_retired_comment: Retired origin ids. carryForwardOrigins restores any previously-published origin the current run does not produce, which is what keeps the Pages origin alive on runs without --pages -- but it also resurrects an origin that was deliberately removed from this file. Naming it here is how a removal sticks.
